name: Hemogram - 6 Part (Diff)
aka: CBC (Complete Blood Count), Complete Hemogram, CBP (Complete Blood Picture), Full Blood Count (FBC)
about: Counts red cells, white cells (6-part differential) and platelets, and measures haemoglobin. Used to check for anaemia, infection and blood disorders.

name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
aka: TSH, Thyrotropin, Thyrotrophin
about: Measures thyroid stimulating hormone. The main test to screen thyroid function.

name: Fasting Blood Sugar
aka: FBS, Fasting Plasma Glucose (FPG), Fasting Blood Glucose (FBG), Glucose - Fasting
about: Measures blood sugar after 8-10 hours of fasting. Used to diagnose and monitor diabetes.

name: HbA1c
aka: Glycated Hemoglobin, Glycosylated Hemoglobin, A1C, Hemoglobin A1c
about: Measures average blood sugar over the past 2-3 months. Used to diagnose and monitor diabetes. Average Blood Glucose (ABG) on the report is a calculated value.

name: Complete Urine Analysis
aka: CUE (Complete Urine Examination), Urine Routine & Microscopy (R/M), Urinalysis, Urine Routine Examination (R/E)
about: Checks the physical, chemical and microscopic features of urine. Used to detect urinary infection and kidney problems.

name: Creatinine - Serum
aka: Serum Creatinine, S. Creatinine, Creat
about: Measures creatinine, a waste product filtered by the kidneys. Used to check kidney function.

name: Postprandial Blood Sugar
aka: PPBS, Postprandial Plasma Glucose (PPG), 2-Hour Postprandial Glucose, Glucose - PP, PPBG
about: Measures blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Used to monitor diabetes.

name: Alanine Transaminase (SGPT)
aka: ALT, SGPT, Alanine Aminotransferase
about: Measures ALT (SGPT), an enzyme found mainly in the liver. Used to check for liver damage.

name: 25-OH Vitamin D (Total)
aka: 25-Hydroxyvitamin D, 25(OH)D, Calcidiol, Vitamin D - Total (D2 + D3)
about: Measures 25-hydroxy vitamin D (D2 + D3). Used to check vitamin D levels.

name: Vitamin B-12
aka: Vit B12, Cobalamin, Serum B12, Vitamin B12 - Serum
about: Measures vitamin B12. Used to check for B12 deficiency.

name: Total Cholesterol
aka: Serum Cholesterol, Cholesterol - Total, TC, CHOL
about: Measures total cholesterol in the blood. Used to assess heart disease risk.

name: Triglycerides
aka: TG, TGL, Serum Triglycerides
about: Measures triglycerides, a type of fat in the blood. Used to assess heart disease risk.

name: HDL Cholesterol - Direct
aka: HDL-C, HDL, High Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol, Direct HDL
about: Measures HDL ('good') cholesterol. Used to assess heart disease risk.

name: LDL Cholesterol - Direct
aka: LDL-C, LDL, Low Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol, Direct LDL
about: Measures LDL ('bad') cholesterol. Used to assess heart disease risk.

name: Aspartate Aminotransferase (SGOT)
aka: AST, SGOT, Aspartate Transaminase
about: Measures AST (SGOT), an enzyme found in the liver and muscles. Used to check liver function.

name: Bilirubin - Total
aka: Total Bilirubin, Serum Bilirubin, T. Bilirubin, TBIL
about: Measures total bilirubin. Used to check liver function and investigate jaundice.

name: Random Blood Sugar
aka: RBS, Random Plasma Glucose, Glucose - Random, RBG
about: Measures blood sugar at any time of day. Used for a quick check of blood sugar.

name: Uric Acid
aka: Serum Uric Acid, Serum Urate
about: Measures uric acid in the blood. Used to check for gout and kidney stone risk.

name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
aka: BUN, Urea Nitrogen, Serum Urea Nitrogen
about: Measures blood urea nitrogen, a waste product removed by the kidneys. Used to check kidney function.

name: Total Triiodothyronine (T3)
aka: T3, Total T3, TT3, Triiodothyronine
about: Measures total T3, a thyroid hormone. Used to check thyroid function.

name: Total Thyroxine (T4)
aka: T4, Total T4, TT4, Thyroxine
about: Measures total T4, the main thyroid hormone. Used to check thyroid function.

name: Free Thyroxine (FT4)
aka: FT4, Free T4
about: Measures free T4, the main thyroid hormone. Used with TSH to check thyroid function.

name: Free Triiodothyronine (FT3)
aka: FT3, Free T3
about: Measures free T3, an active thyroid hormone. Used to check thyroid function.

name: Electrolytes (SOD, POT, CHL)
aka: Serum Electrolytes, Electrolyte Panel, Na / K / Cl, Sodium, Potassium, Chloride
about: Measures sodium, potassium and chloride. Used to check fluid and electrolyte balance.

name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP)
aka: CRP, Serum CRP, C-Reactive Protein Quantitative
about: Measures C-reactive protein. Used to detect inflammation and infection.

name: Calcium
aka: Serum Calcium, Total Calcium, Ca
about: Measures calcium in the blood. Used to check bone, parathyroid and kidney health.

name: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen
aka: HBsAg, Australia Antigen, HBs Antigen
about: Detects hepatitis B surface antigen. A positive result means current hepatitis B infection.

name: Alkaline Phosphatase
aka: ALP, Alk Phos, ALKP, Serum Alkaline Phosphatase
about: Measures alkaline phosphatase, an enzyme from the liver and bones. Used to check liver and bone health.

name: Bilirubin - Direct
aka: Direct Bilirubin, Conjugated Bilirubin, D. Bilirubin, DBIL
about: Measures direct (conjugated) bilirubin. Used to check liver and bile duct function.

name: Albumin - Serum
aka: Serum Albumin, ALB
about: Measures albumin, the main protein made by the liver. Used to check liver, kidney and nutritional health.

name: Protein - Total
aka: Serum Total Protein, Total Serum Protein, TP
about: Measures total protein (albumin and globulins) in the blood. Used to check liver, kidney and nutritional health.

name: Ferritin
aka: Serum Ferritin
about: Measures ferritin, the body's iron store. Used to check for iron deficiency.

name: Gamma Glutamyl Transferase (GGT)
aka: GGT, GGTP, Gamma GT, Gamma Glutamyl Transpeptidase
about: Measures gamma-glutamyl transferase, a liver enzyme. Used to check liver and bile duct health.

name: Iron
aka: Serum Iron, Fe
about: Measures iron in the blood. Used to check for iron deficiency or overload.

name: Dengue virus NS1 Antigen
aka: Dengue NS1 Antigen, NS1 Ag, Dengue Non-Structural Protein 1 Antigen
about: Detects dengue NS1 antigen. Used for early diagnosis of dengue in the first days of fever.

name: Beta HCG
aka: β-hCG, Beta Human Chorionic Gonadotropin, hCG, Serum hCG, Blood Pregnancy Test
about: Measures beta hCG, the pregnancy hormone. Used to confirm and monitor pregnancy.

name: Anti Hepatitis C Virus Antibody
aka: Anti-HCV, HCV Antibody, Hepatitis C Antibody, HCV Ab
about: Detects antibodies to hepatitis C virus. Used to screen for hepatitis C infection.

name: HIV P24 Ag/Ab
aka: HIV 1 & 2 Ag/Ab Combo, 4th Generation HIV Test, HIV Antigen/Antibody Combo, HIV-1/2 Ag/Ab
about: Detects HIV-1/2 antibodies and p24 antigen (4th generation). Used to screen for HIV infection.

name: Anti-Dengue Virus IgM
aka: Dengue IgM, Dengue Antibody IgM, Dengue Virus IgM Antibody
about: Detects IgM antibodies to dengue virus. Used to check for recent dengue infection.

name: Prolactin (PRL)
aka: PRL, Serum Prolactin
about: Measures prolactin, a pituitary hormone. Used to evaluate irregular periods, infertility and breast milk discharge.

name: Total Iron Binding Capacity (TIBC)
aka: TIBC, Iron Binding Capacity - Total
about: Measures total iron binding capacity. Used with serum iron to evaluate iron deficiency.

name: Anti-Dengue Virus IgG
aka: Dengue IgG, Dengue Antibody IgG, Dengue Virus IgG Antibody
about: Detects IgG antibodies to dengue virus. Used to check for past or secondary dengue infection.

name: Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA)
aka: PSA, Total PSA, tPSA, Serum PSA
about: Measures prostate-specific antigen. Used to screen for and monitor prostate cancer.

name: Peripheral Blood Smear (PBS)
aka: Peripheral Smear, Blood Smear, Peripheral Blood Film (PBF), GBP (General Blood Picture)
about: A blood smear examined under a microscope. Used to study blood cells and detect malaria parasites.

name: Luteinising Hormone (LH)
aka: LH, Luteinizing Hormone, Lutropin, Interstitial Cell Stimulating Hormone (ICSH)
about: Measures luteinising hormone. Used to evaluate fertility, periods and menopause.

name: Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH)
aka: FSH, Follitropin
about: Measures follicle stimulating hormone. Used to evaluate fertility, periods and menopause.

name: High Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein (HS-CRP)
aka: hs-CRP, High Sensitive CRP, Cardiac CRP
about: Measures low levels of C-reactive protein. Used to assess heart disease risk.

name: Rheumatoid Factor (RF)
aka: RF, RA Factor, RA Test
about: Detects rheumatoid factor. Used to help diagnose rheumatoid arthritis.

name: Anti – Syphilis Antibody
aka: Treponema pallidum Antibody, Anti-TP, Syphilis Total Antibody, Treponemal Antibody Test
about: Detects antibodies to Treponema pallidum. Used to screen for syphilis.

name: Urinary Microalbumin
aka: Microalbumin - Urine, Urine Albumin, Microalbuminuria Test
about: Detects small amounts of albumin in urine. Used to detect early kidney damage.

name: Folate
aka: Folic Acid, Vitamin B9, Serum Folate
about: Measures folate (vitamin B9). Used to check for folate deficiency and anaemia.

name: Testosterone
aka: Total Testosterone, Serum Testosterone
about: Measures total testosterone, the main male hormone. Used to evaluate hormone balance in men and women.

name: Anti Microsomal Antibody (AMA)
aka: Anti-TPO, Thyroid Peroxidase Antibody, TPO Antibody, Thyroid Microsomal Antibody, Anti-Thyroid Peroxidase Antibody
about: Detects antibodies against thyroid peroxidase (TPO). Used to diagnose autoimmune thyroid disease.

name: Estradiol/Oestrogen (E2)
aka: Estradiol, E2, Oestradiol, 17β-Estradiol
about: Measures estradiol, the main female hormone. Used to evaluate fertility, periods and menopause.

name: Insulin - Fasting
aka: Fasting Insulin, Serum Insulin - Fasting, Fasting Serum Insulin
about: Measures insulin after fasting. Used to check for insulin resistance.

name: Anti Mullerian Hormone (AMH)
aka: AMH, Mullerian Inhibiting Substance (MIS), Mullerian Inhibiting Hormone (MIH)
about: Measures anti-Müllerian hormone. Used to assess ovarian reserve (egg count).

name: Amylase
aka: Serum Amylase, Alpha-Amylase
about: Measures amylase, a digestive enzyme. Used to check for pancreatitis.

name: Lipase
aka: Serum Lipase
about: Measures lipase, a pancreatic enzyme. Used to diagnose pancreatitis.

name: Magnesium
aka: Serum Magnesium, Mg
about: Measures magnesium in the blood. Used to check for magnesium imbalance.

name: Phosphorous
aka: Serum Phosphorus, Inorganic Phosphorus, Phosphate, PO4
about: Measures phosphorus in the blood. Used to check bone, kidney and parathyroid health.

name: Cortisol
aka: Serum Cortisol, Plasma Cortisol
about: Measures cortisol, the main stress hormone. Used to evaluate adrenal gland function.

name: ANA Screen
aka: ANA, Antinuclear Antibody, Anti-Nuclear Antibody Screen, Antinuclear Factor (ANF)
about: Screens for antinuclear antibodies. Used to check for autoimmune diseases such as lupus.

name: Anti - CCP (ACCP)
aka: Anti-Cyclic Citrullinated Peptide Antibody, CCP Antibody, Anti-CCP Antibody, ACPA
about: Detects anti-CCP antibodies. Used to help diagnose rheumatoid arthritis.

name: Homocysteine
aka: Hcy, Total Homocysteine (tHcy), Plasma Homocysteine, Serum Homocysteine
about: Measures homocysteine, an amino acid in the blood. High levels are linked to heart disease.

name: High Sensitivity Troponin I
aka: hs-TnI, hs-cTnI, High Sensitivity Cardiac Troponin I, Troponin I - High Sensitive
about: Measures cardiac troponin I with high sensitivity. Used to diagnose heart attack.

name: Urinogram
aka: Complete Urinogram
about: A routine urine test. Used to screen for urinary infection and kidney problems.

name: Lipoprotein (a)
aka: Lp(a), Lipoprotein Little a
about: Measures lipoprotein(a), a mostly inherited cholesterol particle. Used to assess heart disease risk.

name: NT-proBNP
aka: N-Terminal Pro B-Type Natriuretic Peptide, N-Terminal Pro-Brain Natriuretic Peptide
about: Measures NT-proBNP, released when the heart is under strain. Used to diagnose and monitor heart failure.

name: Carcino Embryonic Antigen (CEA)
aka: CEA, Carcinoembryonic Antigen
about: Measures carcinoembryonic antigen. Used as a tumour marker, mainly for colorectal cancer.

name: CA 125
aka: Cancer Antigen 125, Carbohydrate Antigen 125
about: Measures cancer antigen 125. Used as a tumour marker for ovarian cancer.

name: Progesterone
aka: Serum Progesterone, P4
about: Measures progesterone. Used to confirm ovulation and monitor early pregnancy.

name: Intact Parathyroid Hormone (PTH)
aka: iPTH, Intact PTH, Parathormone, Parathyroid Hormone - Intact
about: Measures parathyroid hormone, which controls blood calcium. Used to evaluate parathyroid and calcium disorders.

name: Hepatitis B Surface Antibody (Anti-HBS)
aka: Anti-HBs, HBsAb, Anti-HBs Antibody
about: Detects antibodies to hepatitis B surface antigen. Shows immunity to hepatitis B.

name: Creatine Phosphokinase
aka: CPK, CK, Creatine Kinase, Total CK, CPK - Total
about: Measures creatine kinase, an enzyme found in muscles and the heart. Used to check for muscle damage.

name: Lactate Dehydrogenase
aka: LDH, LD, Lactic Acid Dehydrogenase, Lactic Dehydrogenase
about: Measures lactate dehydrogenase, an enzyme found in most tissues. Used to detect tissue damage.

name: Apolipoprotein - B (Apo-B)
aka: Apo B, Apolipoprotein B-100, Apo B-100
about: Measures apolipoprotein B, the main protein in LDL cholesterol. Used to assess heart disease risk.

name: Apolipoprotein - A1 (Apo-A1)
aka: Apo A1, Apolipoprotein A-I, ApoA-I
about: Measures apolipoprotein A1, the main protein in HDL cholesterol. Used to assess heart disease risk.

name: Creatinine Phosphokinase (Muscle/Brain)
aka: CK-MB, CPK-MB, Creatine Kinase-MB, CK-2 Isoenzyme
about: Measures CK-MB, the heart form of creatine kinase. Used to check for heart muscle damage.

name: Total IgE
aka: IgE - Total, Serum IgE, Immunoglobulin E
about: Measures total IgE, the allergy antibody. Used to check for allergic conditions.

name: Anti Hepatitis A Virus (HAV) - IgM
aka: HAV IgM, IgM Anti-HAV, Hepatitis A IgM Antibody
about: Detects IgM antibodies to hepatitis A virus. Used to diagnose recent hepatitis A infection.

name: Rubella - IgG
aka: Rubella IgG Antibody, German Measles IgG, Anti-Rubella IgG
about: Detects IgG antibodies to rubella virus. Shows immunity to rubella.

name: Toxoplasma Gondii IgG
aka: Toxoplasma IgG, Toxo IgG, Toxoplasma Antibody IgG
about: Detects IgG antibodies to Toxoplasma gondii. Shows past toxoplasma infection.

name: Cytomegalo Virus (CMV) IgG
aka: CMV IgG, Cytomegalovirus IgG Antibody, Anti-CMV IgG
about: Detects IgG antibodies to cytomegalovirus (CMV). Shows past CMV infection.

name: Toxoplasma Gondii IgM
aka: Toxoplasma IgM, Toxo IgM, Toxoplasma Antibody IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies to Toxoplasma gondii. Used to check for recent toxoplasma infection.

name: Rubella IgM
aka: Rubella IgM Antibody, German Measles IgM, Anti-Rubella IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies to rubella virus. Used to check for recent rubella infection.

name: Cytomegalo Virus (CMV) IgM
aka: CMV IgM, Cytomegalovirus IgM Antibody, Anti-CMV IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies to cytomegalovirus (CMV). Used to check for recent CMV infection.

name: Anti Thyroglobulin Antibody (ATG)
aka: Anti-Tg, TgAb, Thyroglobulin Antibody, Anti-Thyroglobulin
about: Detects antibodies against thyroglobulin. Used to diagnose autoimmune thyroid disease.

name: Alpha Feto Protein (AFP)
aka: AFP, Alpha-Fetoprotein, Alpha-1-Fetoprotein, Serum AFP
about: Measures alpha-fetoprotein. Used as a tumour marker for liver and germ-cell cancers.

name: Insulin - PP
aka: Post Prandial Insulin, PP Insulin, Serum Insulin - PP
about: Measures insulin after a meal. Used to check for insulin resistance.

name: Free PSA
aka: fPSA, Free Prostate Specific Antigen, Unbound PSA
about: Measures free (unbound) PSA. Used with total PSA to evaluate prostate cancer risk.

name: H.pylori IgG
aka: H. pylori Antibody IgG, Helicobacter pylori IgG, Anti-H. pylori IgG
about: Detects IgG antibodies to Helicobacter pylori. Used to check for H. pylori infection of the stomach.

name: CA 19.9
aka: Cancer Antigen 19-9, CA 19-9, Carbohydrate Antigen 19-9
about: Measures cancer antigen 19-9. Used as a tumour marker for pancreatic and digestive tract cancers.

name: CA 15.3
aka: Cancer Antigen 15-3, CA 15-3, Carbohydrate Antigen 15-3
about: Measures cancer antigen 15-3. Used as a tumour marker for breast cancer.

name: DHEA - Sulphate (DHEAS)
aka: DHEA-S, Dehydroepiandrosterone Sulphate
about: Measures DHEA-sulphate, an adrenal hormone. Used to evaluate adrenal function and excess male hormones.

name: Serum Zinc
aka: Zinc - Serum, Zn
about: Measures zinc in the blood. Used to check for zinc deficiency.

name: Anti-dsDNA IgG
aka: Anti-dsDNA, Anti-Double Stranded DNA Antibody, dsDNA Antibody, Anti-nDNA (Native DNA)
about: Detects antibodies against double-stranded DNA. Used to diagnose and monitor lupus (SLE).

name: Hepatitis B Envelope Antigen (HBeAg)
aka: HBeAg, Hepatitis B e Antigen
about: Detects hepatitis B 'e' antigen. Shows active hepatitis B virus multiplication.

name: Hepatitis B Envelope Antibody - AHBE
aka: Anti-HBe, HBeAb, Hepatitis B e Antibody, Anti-HBe Antibody
about: Detects antibodies to hepatitis B 'e' antigen. Used to monitor hepatitis B infection.

name: Anti Hepatitis B Core Antigen (AHBC) - IgM
aka: Anti-HBc IgM, HBcAb IgM, IgM Anti-HBc, Hepatitis B Core Antibody IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies to hepatitis B core antigen. Used to diagnose recent hepatitis B infection.
parameters: Anti Hepatitis B Core Antigen (AHBC) - IgM

name: Anti Hepatitis B Core Antigen (AHBC) - Total
aka: Anti-HBc Total, HBcAb Total, Total Anti-HBc, Hepatitis B Core Antibody Total
about: Detects total antibodies to hepatitis B core antigen. Shows current or past hepatitis B infection.
parameters: Anti Hepatitis B Core Antigen (AHBC) - Total

name: Herpes Simplex Virus 1/2 - IgG
aka: HSV 1 & 2 IgG, HSV 1/2 IgG Antibody, Herpes Simplex Type 1 & 2 IgG
about: Detects IgG antibodies to herpes simplex virus types 1 and 2. Shows past herpes infection.

name: Herpes Simplex Virus 1/2 - IgM
aka: HSV 1 & 2 IgM, HSV 1/2 IgM Antibody, Herpes Simplex Type 1 & 2 IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies to herpes simplex virus types 1 and 2. Used to check for recent herpes infection.

name: Sex Hormone Binding Globulin
aka: SHBG, Testosterone-Estradiol Binding Globulin (TeBG)
about: Measures sex hormone binding globulin. Used with testosterone to evaluate hormone balance.

name: C-Peptide
aka: Connecting Peptide, Insulin C-Peptide, Serum C-Peptide
about: Measures C-peptide, released with insulin by the pancreas. Shows how much insulin the body is making.

name: Serum Copper
aka: Copper - Serum, Cu
about: Measures copper in the blood. Used to check for copper imbalance, such as in Wilson's disease.

name: Thyroglobulin
aka: Tg, Serum Thyroglobulin
about: Measures thyroglobulin, a protein made by the thyroid. Used to monitor thyroid cancer after treatment.

name: Herpes Simplex Virus II - IgG
aka: HSV-2 IgG, HSV Type 2 IgG Antibody, Herpes Simplex Type 2 IgG
about: Detects IgG antibodies to herpes simplex virus type 2. Shows past HSV-2 infection.

name: Herpes Simplex Virus II - IgM
aka: HSV-2 IgM, HSV Type 2 IgM Antibody, Herpes Simplex Type 2 IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies to herpes simplex virus type 2. Used to check for recent HSV-2 infection.

name: Herpes Simplex Virus I - IgG
aka: HSV-1 IgG, HSV Type 1 IgG Antibody, Herpes Simplex Type 1 IgG
about: Detects IgG antibodies to herpes simplex virus type 1. Shows past HSV-1 infection.

name: Herpes Simplex Virus I - IgM
aka: HSV-1 IgM, HSV Type 1 IgM Antibody, Herpes Simplex Type 1 IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies to herpes simplex virus type 1. Used to check for recent HSV-1 infection.

name: Anti-Cardiolipin IgG
aka: ACL IgG, Anticardiolipin Antibody IgG, Cardiolipin Antibody IgG
about: Detects IgG antibodies against cardiolipin. Used to check for antiphospholipid syndrome.

name: Anti-Cardiolipin IgM
aka: ACL IgM, Anticardiolipin Antibody IgM, Cardiolipin Antibody IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies against cardiolipin. Used to check for antiphospholipid syndrome.

name: 17α-OH Progesterone
aka: 17-Hydroxyprogesterone, 17-OHP, 17-OH Progesterone, 17-Alpha Hydroxyprogesterone
about: Measures 17-hydroxyprogesterone, an adrenal hormone. Used to screen for congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH).

name: Growth Hormone
aka: GH, HGH (Human Growth Hormone), Somatotropin, Somatotrophin
about: Measures growth hormone from the pituitary gland. Used to evaluate growth disorders.

name: Anti Hepatitis A Virus (HAV) - Total
aka: Total Anti-HAV, HAV Total Antibody (IgG + IgM), Hepatitis A Total Antibody
about: Detects total antibodies to hepatitis A virus. Shows past infection or immunity.

name: Calcitonin
aka: Thyrocalcitonin, Serum Calcitonin
about: Measures calcitonin, a hormone from the thyroid's C-cells. Used to diagnose and monitor medullary thyroid cancer.

name: Androstenedione
aka: A4, Delta-4-Androstenedione, Serum Androstenedione
about: Measures androstenedione, a precursor of testosterone and estrogen. Used to evaluate excess male hormones and adrenal disorders.

name: Adrenocorticotropic Hormone Test
aka: ACTH, Corticotropin, Adrenocorticotropin, Corticotrophin
about: Measures ACTH, the pituitary hormone that controls cortisol. Used to evaluate adrenal and pituitary disorders.

name: Aldosterone
aka: Serum Aldosterone, Plasma Aldosterone, Plasma Aldosterone Concentration (PAC)
about: Measures aldosterone, an adrenal hormone that controls salt and blood pressure. Used with renin to evaluate high blood pressure.

name: Direct Renin
aka: Direct Renin Concentration (DRC), Plasma Renin Concentration (PRC), Renin - Direct
about: Measures renin, a kidney enzyme that controls blood pressure. Used with aldosterone to evaluate high blood pressure.

name: Chlamydia pneumoniae IgM
aka: C. pneumoniae IgM, Chlamydophila pneumoniae IgM, Chlamydia pneumoniae Antibody IgM
about: Detects IgM antibodies to Chlamydia pneumoniae. Used to check for recent respiratory infection by this bacterium.

name: Lipoprotein Associated Phospholipase A2
aka: Lp-PLA2, PLAC Test, Platelet-Activating Factor Acetylhydrolase (PAF-AH)
about: Measures Lp-PLA2, an enzyme linked to artery inflammation. Used to assess heart disease risk.
